title: Historical Places in India: Monuments and Heritage Destinations

excerpt: A practical guide to planning a heritage trip in India: choosing a region and theme, how long to allow, the best seasons, weekly monument closures, booking ASI and state monument tickets online, hiring licensed guides, photography and drone rules, dress codes at living temples and mosques, pacing, heat and travelling with children or older relatives.
